cicciṭāyati.cp: onom. hisses; fizzes; makes the sound chit chit.
cicciṭāyati.p: [Cicciṭa+āya+ti] (kri) Google Translate He makes a sound: 'Sit, sit, sit, sit.' .
a: စိစ္စိဋာယတိ(ကြိ)
[စိစ္စိဋ+အာယ+တိ]
စိဋ်စိဋ်-ဖျစ်ဖျစ်-စီစီ-ဟူသော အသံကိုပြု၏၊ စိဋ်စိဋ်-ဖျစ်ဖျစ်-စီစီ-မည်၏။

DOP: cicciṭāyati cicciṭāti pr. 3 sg. [ onomat. ], hisses, makes a hissing sound ; Vin I 225, 27 (seyyathā pi nāma phālo divasaṃ santatto udake pakkhitto ~āyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati) = S I 169, 8 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se viciṭāyati viṭiciṭāyati) = Sn p. 15, 11 (Pj II 154, 24 : ~āyati ciṭiciṭāyatī ti evaṃ saddaṃ karoti); A I 127, 7 (tindukālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhīyosomattāya ~āyati ciṭiciṭāyati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ciciṭāyati; Mp II 198, 4 foll. : taṃ hi jhāyamānaṃ pakatiyā pi papaṭikāyo muñcantaṃ ~āti ( or cicciṭā ti?) ciṭiciṭā ti saddaṃ karoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ciciṭāti ciciṭā ti) = Pp 36, 32 ; Mil 258, 28 (imaṃ udakaṃ aggimhi tappamānaṃ ~āyati ciṭiciṭāyati saddāyati bahuvidhaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pipidāyati paṭipidāyati); Thī-a 6, 16 (~āyati ciṭiciṭāyati); Sadd 587, 13 (saddo cicciṭam iva attānaṃ ācarati ~āyati); 822, 8 (dhātuliṅgānukaraṇehi paccayā … ~āyati).
NCP: pr. 3 sg. | cicci.taayati hisses; fizzes; makes the sound “chit-chit”; makes a hissing sound.

DOP: cicciṭi ind. [ onomat. ], (a hissing sound) ssssssss! hiss! Thī 24 (rāgaṃ ca ahaṃ dosaṃ ca ~i ~ī ti vihanāmi, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se vicchindantī viharāmi; Thī-a 28, 22 : ~i ~ī ti iminā saddena saddhiṃ vihanāmi vināsemi, pajahāmī ti attho, eds so ) — see also ciṭiciṭi.
